steps.content: After taking down the last Puppet advancing through the hall, you can finally approach your targets.
[Jelena's and Elvira's portraits]
When you turn to them, the two visibly tense up, with Elvira flinching further behind Jelena. After a moment's thought, you decide to adopt a cover identity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ms. Bernadette Cavendish holds great respect for the former Prime Minister. She's deeply concerned for the safety of his family and has entrusted me with protecting the two of you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We received some intelligence from Councilor Cavendish, and as a result, the agency sent me to ensure the safety of the Prime Minister's family.
Confusion lingers on the guardian's face—she evidently does not recognize your supposed employer, and this only makes the request seem more suspicious.
But now isn't the time to dwell on such details.
BOOM—!! An explosive noise erupts outside, followed by constant gunshots and screams, a stark reminder that the battle isn't over. You quickly establish contact with Hecate.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There's still a sizable group at the east gate—all Underground Puppets of the same type. The sorcery is likely deployed somewhere nearby.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Quite a few guests have fled outside the building, some of them already injured. Their situation is dangerous. We've received orders to prioritize their protection at all costs.

Puppets of a new type, VIP protection—these phrases trigger memories of the cabinet massacre, where elite HUSH units were decimated. If your companions outside were to confront such formidable enemies... you don't even dare to entertain that thought.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Tell everyone not to take unnecessary risks. I'll be right there.

You turn to the people behind you—several ladies of status and some civilians who couldn't escape in time. A few others have remained, seemingly in an attempt to protect the vulnerable ones around them.
Looks like some of these dignitaries still have guts, particularly this disheveled but dignified gentleman. You compose yourself and give him a respectful nod.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sir, would you please escort them to safety? The evacuation route is that way, and take a right at the end.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The enemies are all gathering at the east gate. I'll draw their attention away from you. Don't worry; I'll make sure you get out safely.
The man gazes at you for a moment before firmly grasping your hand in a gesture of solemn promise.

steps.speaker: Man in Red
steps.content: I'll get them to safety and wait for your return. You have my word.
...He seems like a genuinely reliable person, but more importantly, one of your listening devices is planted on him. In the event of any mishap, you will be able to react promptly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you, sir.
Before leaving, you want to check on the girl one last time, but someone steps forward to block your way.
Once again, the butler positions herself protectively in front of the young girl. Her eyes meet yours without hostility, yet they are unmistakably filled with dread.
You realize you are not the only one to blame—it's an instinctive response born from years of constant uncertainty. Acknowledging this, you take a step back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's all right now. I'm here to protect you. I won't come closer without your permission, I promise.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just want to check on Miss Stewart's condition. She's just experienced severe shock and has shown intense physical reactions. Now...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...I will protect her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: From here on, please stay by her side at all times. I'll draw the enemies away while you escort the young lady to safety with the others. Get to shelter as quickly as possible.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At least you're not alone anymore. There are some people ready to protect you—people who genuinely want to keep you safe.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Thank you.
At last, her tension melts away as she gives you a graceful nod of appreciation.

steps.speaker: Man in Red
steps.content: This way! Hurry!
You wait until everyone disappears down the corridor before steeling yourself and leaving the mansion to embrace the battle ahead.
Outside the mansion, a scene of chaos unfolds. Though casualties are not severe, a majority of the combat forces are still assigned to offer comfort to the distinguished guests in great shock.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, this way.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm fine, and so is everyone else. The enemies are not too hard to deal with, having only caused minimal damage.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But they move too fast. With so many civilians on site we need more time to secure the area.
Seeing Hecate's composure puts your mind at ease. Your attention quickly turns to the Puppet pinned to the ground by Nightmare.
The Puppet matches the model of those that attacked the cabinet, but inexplicably, you feel something is amiss.

Since earlier in the mansion, you have noticed that these Puppets only possess limited combat abilities and also lack intelligence. They wouldn't pose much of a threat if there weren't so many civilians to protect here.
Then... how did these unremarkable Puppets manage to take down the elite HUSH units guarding the cabinet?
While you are lost in contemplation, the roar of engines suddenly reverberates through your earpiece.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!
As if triggered by a signal, the Puppets suddenly activate in unison, their heads snapping in the same direction.
A car bursts through the back gate of the mansion, and you see a few familiar faces inside.
We made it out! Still got room in the car. Should we go back for more?

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Sir, they're too far away, and the monsters have already spotted us. We should leave now. Our current passengers' safety should come first.
Alright then. Open the roof, I'll give him a shout!
steps.female_content: Alright then. Open the roof, I'll give her a shout!

steps.content: As the car speeds past, you see the sunroof open and a man in a dark red suit spring up, waving energetically at you.
Hey, bro! I'm gonna take 'em to safety first! Come find us once you've cleaned up this mess. I'll be waitin'!
steps.female_content: Hey, sis! I'm gonna take 'em to safety first! Come find us once you've cleaned up this mess. I'll be waitin'!

steps.content: The name's <color=#fb9259>Max King</color>! Great to meet you, Chief of MBCC!

Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 27th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I am Max King, the primary candidate in this election. I have always held your reputation in high regard and would like to extend my heartfelt greetings and deep respect to you! Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 28th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I am Max King, the leading candidate in this election. I am eagerly anticipating having a discussion with you! Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 29th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I have been closely following your remarkable career, and your achievements never fail to impress me! It's striking how our views align on matters concerning the West District, FAC, and even Paradeisos. We could...
The name suddenly strikes you as familiar—it's the election candidate who has sent you twenty-nine mails.
His speedy exit, while being flashy, has attracted a trail of Underground Puppets hot on his heels, like a pack of wild dogs chasing after a running bone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...That fool! Hecate, after them!
